decisions.reason: The stronger mixing-quality target does not necessarily change the selected bowl capacity or form; the existing capacity priorities already account for mixing quality and foam consistency.
The candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY for the independently stated splash-control requirements; the mixing-quality change adds no further candidate-state update.
The stronger texture and foam target does not select a whisk configuration. The candidate's same-message AMBIGUOUS Event already captures the unresolved whisk-head choice.
The candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY for clean, controlled, seamless, non-sputtering flow; the mixing-result change requires no additional dispensing-state change.
Cleanability is independently specified in the source message and already captured by a same-message MODIFY; the mixing-quality change adds no further cleanability update.
A stronger froth and smoothness target does not necessarily alter the existing event-use reliability requirement.
The source reaffirms the already selected solenoid approach but does not change the existing valve mechanism or button-actuation behavior.
The mixing-quality change has no effect on the machine's brand text, placard placement, or intended viewer.
The source reiterates no-drip and leak-prevention behavior already present in the candidate state without changing those requirements.
The desired mixing result does not change the 120V input source, V1 battery exclusion, or power architecture.
The stronger mixing-quality target does not change the DJ-turntable visual theme.
The mixing-quality change has no effect on the beige and green enclosure color scheme.
